label: Deterministic copying rules can switch arbitrarily late
paraphrase: Every stipulated Boolean schedule of copy or toggle rules gives an individually deterministic Profile with a unique complete trace. A schedule that copies before any arbitrarily late k and toggles from k onward shares the earlier prefix with the always-copy law but has the opposite transition at k and opposite state at k+1. Any complete trace initially true can be retrospectively coded by one such deterministic schedule. No causal origin, metaphysical accessibility or prospective availability of that schedule is proved.
